findings.claim: This repository still produces the old wording ('You can only add up to 0 more.') when the limit is reached, so its error message is now inconsistent with the fixed message in the sibling space-safes repository.

This repository still produces the old wording ('You can only add up to 0 more.') when the limit is reached, so its error message is now inconsistent with the fixed message in the sibling space-safes repository.

This e2e test still asserts the old error text '...maximum of 1 Address Book Items. You can only add up to 0 more.', which will need to be updated if the other repositories' messages are ever fixed to match, since the three Workspace limit errors now read differently from one another.

If maxSafesPerSpace is lowered in config below the number of Safes a Space already has, the remaining count becomes negative, and before this change that produced a message reading 'up to -N more'; no test covers this edge case after the fix.

The new test inserts a user, a wallet, and a member, copied from a neighboring test, even though the create() call under test only uses spaceId, so a single space row would likely suffice and the extra setup is unnecessary.
